answer: Sybil defence comes from the bond an agent stakes before its identity counts. Each new worker locks collateral slashed only after peers attest real work, so a swarm of fresh keys cannot vote for itself. Minting a thousand clones means buying a thousand positions, then watching them bleed as graders strip unverified submissions. The attacker pays per head; honest nodes post once and later recover it. Like a toll collected before you cross a dune, the exposure lands on whoever cut false markers into the shale beneath the tundra.
